eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket heavily favors 26°C (42.5%) and 27°C (34.5%) for Warsaw's highest temperature on May 4, driven by the latest ECMWF, GFS, and IMGW forecast ensembles clustering daytime highs at 26–28°C amid a high-pressure ridge ushering warm southwest air advection, clear skies, and strong solar insolation.
